entities.name: Hafız Süleymanoğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hafız Süleymanoğlu, formerly known as Hafız Süleymanov, is a retired Turkish weightlifter of Azerbaijani origin competing in bantamweight and featherweight divisions. He held world and European champion titles.
